metadata.description: Block Claude Code from re-proposing an approach you rejected — it refuses and quotes your reason back — then pair on findings, options, and plans in a rich local review UI.

plugins.name: deeppairing
plugins.description: A rejection gate that stops a concept you've turned down before the edit lands: the tool call is refused and your own reason is quoted back, in the project where you rejected it — and, once you enable cross-project publishing, flagged (advisory) on your other projects too. Around it, a local companion UI where structured findings / specs / options / plans are shaped with you, with concept-naming for learning — so your taste compounds.
